measurement_design.seed_to_engine: SHA256(UTF8 declared seed string), 64 lowercase hex chars; no salt or reseeding
measurement_design.random_profile: SHA256(UTF8(seed+":player:"+zero_based_player_index)) first8hex uint32 modulo5 -> comfort; SHA256(UTF8(seed+":edge:"+a+":"+b)) first8hex uint32 modulo6 -> [just_met,friendship,crush,situationship,in_relationships,not_a_friend]. Every generated directed edge explicit=true.
measurement_design.participants: playerId(i), canonical lower UUID, i=0..N-1; snapshot canonical sorting; first unordered pair indices0,1
measurement_design.index_assignment: invariants mode=[questions,truth_or_dare,yes_but][index%3], context=[online,in_person][floor(index/3)%2], rounds=1+index%100; other sections have Cartesian explicit strata
measurement_design.inference_sample: 100 train and400 holdout per class per42strata N2..8 x3modes x2contexts; pooled4200 train /16800 holdout per class. First100 indices exactly one each round count1..100; holdout four each; capabilities=[private_text_chat] in BOTH contexts, because this synthetic mixed-context fixture explicitly requires it; production capability availability is not asserted
measurement_design.observer_scope: Public-channel-only observation: at selectedN2..7 an unselected authenticated room member can observe when a room slot is available; at selectedN8 room capacity8 precludes a ninth spectator, so this is the public component of a participating member view. Observer-owned edges and targeted private invitations/prompts are excluded from this diagnostic and require separate structural secret-field/ACL checks.
measurement_design.lifecycle: Each round starts with public snapshot. Private invitation yields two further snapshots (acks). Truth-or-dare always chooses truth in one mutation. Bilateral action yields two snapshots (acks, second activates); terminal finish one snapshot. No condition/refusal injected. Nonbilateral no-choice starts active. Private condition/offer/card/actor details never included.
measurement_design.metadata: Global per-session revisions start1 and increase1 per modeled mutation; public game_rev and stream_rev equal. at_tick starts0, increases1 per modeled mutation; fixed common clock offset irrelevant. Count frame UTF8 JSON bytes with actual fixed-length deterministic round UUID and decimal revisions/ticks, not private frame sizes. Observe every mutation, a conservative maximum versus ticker coalescing.
measurement_design.feature_serialization: publicFeatureNames exact order: interactions4, visible_role8, ordered_first8, ordered_second8, ordered_pair64 row-major, private_stage4, round_state5, response_state5, choice3, metadata7, then public card IDs in FrozenPack canonical card order. All counts/sums divided by total committed rounds. Visible role includes actors plus literal synthetic display-name token rendered in public text. Private card ID/actors never enter features.
measurement_design.classifier: Per-stratum and pooled diagonal LDA trained independently. Difference of class1 and class0 means divided by average unbiased within-class variance +1e-9; midpoint intercept. No holdout coefficient/orientation choice. Exact held-out scores stored in report; pooling does not combine differently scaled stratum scores.
measurement_design.structural_decoder: Each exact single-feature value -> class dictionary learned only on train; overlap rejects decoder. Block when disjoint train dictionaries classify every held-out observation of both classes. This finite check is not a universal nonlinear privacy proof.
measurement_design.output: Report contains raw section counters, deterministic seed formulas/ranges, source SHA and source inventory SHA, raw protocol/runner/adapter/fixture hashes, pack canonical digest; no seed selection after outcomes.
